purpose: Prove a Stage 0 native project-file metadata writer policy for JSON-friendly project containers without claiming full editor rewrite preservation or Aseprite/LibreSprite User Data chunk writing.

external_anchors.used_for: Piskel serializes descriptor description into the project JSON envelope.
Piskel reads the project description back into the descriptor.
Pixelorama .pxo stores project metadata in data.json inside a zip container.
Aseprite User Data Chunk 0x2020 is treated as a future full chunk-model writer, not Stage 0 header-boundary work.

limitations: Stage 0 native metadata writer covers Piskel description and Pixelorama data.json only.
Editor rewrite preservation is not verified by this lab.
Aseprite/LibreSprite User Data chunks require a separate full chunk-model writer.
